tx_pending_due_to_insufficient_gas.meaning: the submitted transaction has insufficient gas and remains pending, not yet mined
tx_pending_due_to_insufficient_gas.checkpoint: before the delayed transaction is mined

executed_after_intended_deadline.meaning: the delayed transaction is executed at a time later than its intended deadline, i.e. outside the time bound the deadline should enforce
executed_after_intended_deadline.checkpoint: at execution of the delayed transaction

executed_at_disadvantage_to_submitter.meaning: the delayed transaction is executed by a malicious actor or MEV bot at a disadvantage to the original submitter
executed_at_disadvantage_to_submitter.checkpoint: at execution of the delayed transaction

assumptions: The deadline argument is intended to bound the time within which the transaction may execute, per the security intent.
The delayed transaction is the same increaseLiquidityCurrentRange call submitted by the original submitter.

unresolved.description: Report gives no concrete deadline value or intended-deadline timestamp, so the 'after intended deadline' relation is represented as a grounded Boolean rather than a numeric time comparison.
Report does not state a specific delayed execution incident or the exact disadvantage magnitude; impacts are described as possible.

limitations: Impact is described as potential; the plan encodes the possibility scenario, not a confirmed incident.
No numeric deadline or delay duration is available, so temporal ordering is captured qualitatively.
The separate impact delayed_tx_executed_later is not formalized by this plan.
